overview.title: Customer intelligence center
overview.subtitle: A unified view of lifecycle, economic value, risk, and data quality without creating a parallel CRM.
overview.refreshHelp: Recomputes all derived customer profiles from canonical data. It does not mutate the canonical Customer record.
overview.totalHelp: Active eligible customers with a Phase 15 derived profile. Administrative users are excluded from this population.
overview.activeRepeatHelp: Customers with at least two counted orders and a purchase within the last 60 days under the current lifecycle engine.
overview.atRiskHelp: Customers whose last counted order was 61–120 days ago. This is a lifecycle rule, not an ML probability.
overview.highValueHelp: Customers whose combined RFM score falls in the high-value band. Boundaries are relative to the same tenant population.
overview.revenueLtvHelp: Paid-order value minus canonical recorded refunds. This differs from the existing gross relationship Lifetime Spend metric.
overview.lifecycleHelp: Purchase lifecycle is kept separate from value and risk so VIP status, churn risk, and purchase stage do not collapse into one label.
overview.qualityHelp: Shows data readiness, contribution-economics availability, and predictive-model calibration. Missing models are never replaced with invented scores.
overview.phase12Missing: Contribution LTV is shown only when the Phase 12 economics ledger has sufficient coverage.
overview.nextActionHelp: Phase 15 only produces NBA candidates. Execution must pass through the canonical Recommendation/Decision/Policy layer; without it, execution remains candidate-only.

detail.sectionHelp: A rebuildable derived profile from commerce, refund, support, and consent data. It does not replace the canonical Customer record.
detail.lifecycleHelp: Current purchase state based on order count and recency. Transition reason and engine version are retained.
detail.rfmHelp: Recency, Frequency, and Monetary scores relative to the same tenant population. Higher is better within each axis.
detail.riskHelp: Currently derived from lifecycle rules. Churn probability remains hidden until a calibrated model exists.
detail.valueHelp: Derived from combined RFM and intentionally independent from lifecycle and risk.
detail.historicalRevenueHelp: Canonical paid gross value minus recorded refunds for this customer.
detail.historicalContributionHelp: Read from the canonical Phase 12 Order Economics Ledger. Incomplete order coverage or ledger quality remains explicitly partial or unavailable instead of being inferred from revenue.
detail.nextPurchaseHelp: The baseline engine returns a heuristic window from observed purchase cadence; it has no probability and is not a deterministic forecast.
detail.supportHelp: Open tickets and 90-day ticket count from canonical support_tickets.
detail.refundsHelp: Canonical refund amount linked to this customer's orders and deducted from historical revenue LTV.
detail.consentHelp: Displays existing consent truth only. Phase 15 does not create new or implied permission.
detail.nbaHelp: Explainable candidates such as service follow-up, win-back, or no-incentive-needed. They are not execution and must pass through Decision/Policy.

segments.title: Customer segment studio
segments.subtitle: Keep existing Saved Views and add secure, versioned definitions for intelligence-driven segments.
segments.name: Segment name
segments.definitionHelp: Only allowlisted Phase 15 features are accepted. Arbitrary SQL and arbitrary column names are rejected.
segments.kindHelp: Kind supports governance and reporting; membership logic is stored in the versioned definition.
segments.refreshPolicyHelp: Manual segments evaluate only on operator command. Event-driven segments reconcile after canonical customer, order, refund, or ticket changes.
segments.previewHelp: Shows match count and sample Customer IDs without changing materialized membership.
segments.empty: No segments have been created yet.

cohorts.title: Cohorts & lifecycle
cohorts.subtitle: Compare acquisition cohorts by entry month and current lifecycle state.
cohorts.cohortHelp: The current cohort uses canonical Customer creation month. First-purchase and channel cohorts can be added later without changing this page contract.
cohorts.revenueHelp: Total historical net revenue LTV for members of the same cohort and lifecycle state.
cohorts.empty: No cohort data exists yet. Recompute customer intelligence first.
